_comment: C.U.R.E known-bad SHA-256 seed list. The first three entries are synthetic TEST/DEMO fixtures - hashes of literal ASCII strings, not real malware samples. The EICAR entry is the industry-standard anti-virus test file (eicar.com plaintext payload): every AV vendor treats it as a real detection, and it exists precisely so scanners can be tested against a genuine malicious-file signature without shipping actual malware. Extend this list only with hashes you are authorized to test.
